people.name: Ephah
people.line: Arabian tribe; known for their camels and dromedaries

people.name: Midian
people.line: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges

people.name: Sheba
people.line: Kingdom known for wealth, trade, and the Queen of Sheba

translations.web: A multitude of camels will cover you, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah. All from Sheba will come. They will bring gold and frankincense, and will proclaim the praises of Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Caravans of camels will cover your land, young camels of Midian and Ephah, and all from Sheba will come, bearing gold and frankincense and proclaiming the praises of the LORD.
translations.kjv: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the LORD.
translations.asv: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come; they shall bring gold and frankincense, and shall proclaim the praises of Jehovah.
